project_type: React 19 SPA with TanStack Router/Start, Supabase backend, deployed to Cloudflare Workers
build_system: Vite + Bun, deployed via wrangler to Cloudflare
test_framework: No unit test framework configured; Playwright for e2e
verification_instructions: 1. Run `bunx tsc --noEmit` to validate types. 2. Run `bun run build` to validate full build.
setup_instructions: Dependencies are pre-installed in node_modules. Just run build/typecheck commands.
environment_constraints: No external network for installing packages. All dependencies already in node_modules. Supabase edge functions are deployed separately (Deno).
contribution_requirements: Code uses shadcn/ui components, Tailwind CSS 4, TanStack Query for data fetching, supabase-js client for backend calls.
key_patterns: Email sending: `supabase.functions.invoke('send-client-email', { body: { to, subject, html, text } })`. UI dialogs use @radix-ui AlertDialog and Dialog components from src/components/ui/. Toast notifications via sonner. Mutations via @tanstack/react-query useMutation.
directory_structure: src/components/dashboard/ - dashboard components including booking dialog. src/components/ui/ - shadcn/ui components. src/routes/_authenticated/ - app pages. supabase/functions/ - Deno edge functions. src/integrations/supabase/ - supabase client setup. src/lib/ - shared utilities including auth.
